headline: Furious Firing on Callahan's Passage; Linn Mercy Works Change Hands
war_summary: Since the last edition the fighting has shifted rather than slackened. Linn Mercy, which counted two Warden works at this desk's previous writing, now shows ten Colonial works and one patch of no-man's-land, with no Warden holdout left; the guns there have cooled somewhat, though twenty-two actions were logged in the day. The Weathered Expanse has lost another work to no-man's-land — four Warden, one Colonial and four unclaimed remain — and its shelling, roughly 600 Colonial and 730 Warden casualties in the past hour, runs a touch hotter than the hour before. Marban Hollow now reports three Colonial, two Warden and three unclaimed works, its engagement hottest of all in the last two hours. The Nevish Line's lone unclaimed work has passed to Warden hands, leaving eight of eight. Callahan's Passage posts the heaviest hourly losses on the map, better than a thousand Colonial and near nine hundred Warden, with no works yet changing hands. Mooring County's twelve Warden works stand, both sides having traded captures there in recent hours. Elsewhere the map remains largely Colonial, Warden strength concentrated in the north and west.
